lines.10: 12 ke factor pairs bataiye: 1 aur 12, 2 aur 6, 3 aur 4. Ab dekhiye, kaunse pair ka sum 7 banta hai. x² − 7x + 12 ka factorisation kariye.

lines.12: Theek hai, Arjun. Pehle common factor bahar nikaalne wala, bilkul seedha step karte hain. 6x + 9 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.13: Bilkul, aapne common factor 3 sahi nikala aur dono terms check karke 3(2x + 3) paaya. Ab 4x + 10 ka factorisation kijiye. x² + 5x + 6 ka factorisation kaunsa ha
lines.14: Aapne 2 aur 3 kaise chune, Arjun—kaunsa sum aur product check kiya?

lines.0: Hi Saanvi, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll make 11 to 20 with ten and some more. What music do you like?
lines.1: Saanvi, your “Dilon ka shooter, mera scooter” question noted—we’ll return at the end. Pick: ten sticks or one box of ten?
lines.2: Great, Saanvi. Ten sticks tied together make one ten-bundle. Add four loose sticks: what number do we see?
lines.3: One bundle is ten. If we add two loose sticks, we have ten and two more; now try our four loose sticks.
lines.4: You showed one bundle and four loose sticks. What do we do next? Fourteen is one ___ and some ones.
lines.5: You counted the bundle as one object. What do we do next? Fourteen is one ___ and some ones.
lines.6: You have one bundle and four loose ones. Say the sentence again, leaving the blank for the bundle’s name. What do we do next? Fourteen is one ___ and some ones.
lines.7: The bundle shows ten sticks. “One ten” is the clear way to say it. One bundle of 10 sticks and 2 loose sticks. How many sticks?
lines.8: Yes, twelve. One bundle is ten, and two loose sticks make twelve. How many is one ten and five ones?
lines.9: A bundle is ten, and loose sticks are counted after ten. 17 is 1 ten and how many ones?
lines.10: This feels tricky, and getting stuck is okay. Look only at the second digit of 17; it tells the loose ones. 17 is 1 ten and how many ones?
lines.11: It is okay to pause. Say the last digit aloud; it tells the number of ones. 17 is 1 ten and how many ones?
lines.12: Yes, Saanvi, seven ones is right. The last digit tells ones. For 14, how many ones does it show?
lines.13: Yes, Saanvi: 14 shows one ten and four ones. Fourteen is 1 ten and 4 ones. How do we write it: 14 or 41?
lines.14: Bilkul, Saanvi. Tumne tens ki place pehle rakhkar sahi number choose kiya. For fourteen, Riya writes 14 and Sonu writes 41. Who is right?

lines.0: Hi Nisha, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll learn fractions as equal shares. What music do you enjoy?
lines.1: Nisha, Doraemon and Chhota Bheem songs with Priya made lunch break giggly. If two share one roti equally, what happens?
lines.2: Nisha, three equal shares are called thirds. One share is one-third, written 1/3. What could three equal roti pieces look like?
lines.3: Nisha, “one-third of 12 mangoes” asks for one equal share after 12 are split into 3 groups. What is one group called?
lines.4: Keep going with the three equal groups.
lines.5: A fraction tells how many equal groups are chosen from all the equal groups. Fill the gap: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
lines.6: Yes, you chose 3 equal groups in the bottom number. A rope is cut into 3 pieces of different lengths. Is each piece one-third of the rope?
lines.7: Right, Nisha: you noticed that unequal pieces are not equal shares. Two same-sized rectangular school flags each have 4 coloured sections. Flag A has 4 equal se
lines.8: You picked Flag A. On which flag is one section definitely one-quarter: A or B?
lines.9: Nisha, look at whether all four sections are the same size. Count the equal sections, then choose the flag. On which flag is one section definitely one-quarter:
lines.10: Yes, Nisha—Flag A is right: four equal sections make quarters. What number tells the whole?
lines.11: A chocolate bar has 5 equal parts and 2 are eaten. What fraction is eaten?
lines.12: Nisha, say it once more, or tap one choice: 2/5, 3/5, or 2/3. A chocolate bar has 5 equal parts and 2 are eaten. What fraction is eaten?
lines.13: Nisha, you counted the 3 parts left; the bottom number counts all 5 equal parts. A chocolate bar has 5 equal parts and 2 are eaten. What fraction is eaten?
lines.14: Yes, Nisha: bottom number means all equal parts; top means eaten parts. Try: 1/3 of 12 is how many?
